protocol.question: Does fitting actual post-reset class margins, with native, TA and AGA compensation, address the previous projection loss and ordinary AGA failure?
protocol.construction: Keep the same parent, rank-nine O directions, budgets, optimizer, and even-image views. Replace squared residual projection loss by the mean positive teacher-class margin of the actual final classifier under public B reset, equally normalized in the ordinary TA and AGA contexts. AGA uses the same differentiable ridge map with unchanged 1e-8 regularizer. Fit one B correction jointly to the parent block features in native, TA and AGA-TA, with the known AGA column permutation applied only to the aligned correction design. Full B reset erases that B correction, isolating the O change for both reset conditions.
protocol.validation: Same source checks and frozen release rules as the projection fit. Use the fixed original AGA kernel to verify the differentiable O output and the aligned B permutation. Read all five counts on the 400 odd synthetic views. Natural images and partner parameters are not used in construction or selection.
protocol.scope: No partners or real images in construction. One finite source point, no amplification of the closed O or parameter sweep. Primary natural evaluation follows only after source eligibility.
